Help
fields.options:
Open thinkNXG Attendance Reconciliation, set filters and click Preview. Nothing changes until you click Reconcile Selected or Reconcile All Eligible.

Only absences created by thinkNXG HR Auto Attendance, or ticked Approve Absence Reconciliation, are corrected. Approved or pending leave, attendance requests, submitted salary or overtime slips and the freeze date block correction. Every correction is recorded in thinkNXG Attendance Reconcile Log.
